summary: Checks that state which must carry across several agent calls in one design run is not lost when it is rebuilt for each call.
purpose: Catches a repeated defect: a value that builds up over several calls gets reset each time, and the reset passes every normal test.
why: The file's opening description records three past defects of this kind, each of which passed tests before a reviewer found it.
how: Lists the mechanisms that span calls, checks that the list matches the pipeline loop's own variables, and then tests that each mechanism accumulates across revision passes and resumes correctly after a stop.
inputs: Sample records, stub model clients and helper functions from the revision test file.
outputs: Pass or fail results for each check.
risks: Relies on helper functions from the revision test file, so changing those helpers breaks these tests. Async tests depend on the chosen async backend.
debug: Find the failing test name and read the matching mechanism in the pipeline module. If the completeness check fails, a new loop variable was probably added without a matching entry.
